env.app: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$TMPDIR/ud-followup-hud-biome (empty at the start) bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9337
env.runs: `actions` ran in process 1 (the code as handed over, then the PlayerCard fix arrived by HMR at the end). `afterFix` ran in process 2: a fresh `bun run dev` on the SAME userData after the fix, so the two places and the witnessed chunks were already in the save and no model call was needed
env.locale: zh-TW (system default); en and ja chosen through Title → System → Language
env.build: main at 9642f9a + the uncommitted rev 6 phase-1 working tree (bun run dev); renderer on localhost:5174 because the user's dev server holds 5173
env.replayNotes: The `eval` steps import dev modules (/state/index.ts, /engine/playerProbe.ts) from the Vite dev server only to read state and positions; every action that changes the game is a click or a key. The walking holds match this seed's land and where the model put the places (東 → chunk 1·0 and 2·0); a replay whose model writes different ground may need other holds. The tree detour (D 500 ms) is specific to this land.

model: openai · gpt-5.4-mini (System → Model default; key from .env)

actions.eval: (async()=>{const t0=Date.now();for(let i=0;i<360;i++){if(/已記/.test(document.body.innerText))return Date.now()-t0;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}return 'still writing';})()

(async()=>{const s=await import('/state/index.ts');const p=s.useSessionStore.getState().place;const w=s.useWorldStore.getState().scene;const card=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e=>e.style&&e.style.borderLeft&&e.style.borderLeft.includes('3px'));return JSON.stringify({place:p&&[p.id,p.title,p.graph.biome],worldSceneBiome:w.value?w.value.biome:w.status,chunk:s.useEngineStore.getState().chunk,nearby:s.useEngineStore.getState().nearby,lang:document.documentElement.lang,card:card&&card.innerText,biomeWord:card?/地貌|Biome|バイオーム|COUNTRYSIDE/i.test(card.innerText):null})})()
